report.summary: The report is well-sourced overall, with all but one citation directly supported by the cited excerpts. The only issue is the ₹50 trillion infrastructure target incorrectly attributed to page 58 instead of page 22 (where the target is stated). All financial figures, names, dates, and percentages match the filing pages exactly.
